original_config.G2_training_gate: only if both folds worthwhile+FDE-safe, and each validation fold edge replacement>=.25 and changed-nonempty-graph fraction>=.5; then train G2 on both folds, same budget; otherwise structural-only/incomplete performance
original_config.audit: old Full29/30 trainable weights x BN-running buffers factorial, all921 old Zara2 validation windows, fixed checkpoint inference only
original_config.evaluation: all three K modes every epoch; independent K20 minima; common CPU standard-normal20 bank per window SHA(seed314159:window_id), batch padding independent
original_config.extra_seed_action: recommend42/2026 only if both folds pass worthwhile ADE and FDE gate; do not run them in Stage4.2
original_config.family: new small controlled temporal-CNN family inspired by public graph prediction; not the frozen Social-STGCNN architecture, not novel method

graph.confound: G2 distance distribution/source-degree changes; not distance-matched proof; G1 vsG0 no diagonal coefficient or normalization architecture change
graph.control: same-window/co-observed/nonself sources; same receiver degree/weight multiset, stable ID-keyed random source order;4m prior relaxed intentionally
graph.weights: exp(-distance2/(2*sigma2)), nonself within4m, offdiag row-normalized only; empty row0

original_config.loss: unchanged official PDF-clamped Gaussian NLL; vectorized exact formula with per-window means
original_config.normalization: shared PersonTemporalNorm: per node/channel observed/predicted time-axis only, eps1e-5, train=eval, no running moments or cross-node stats
original_config.previous_selection: Stage4.1 validation NLL; never claim same-selection comparison
original_config.selection: minimum validation target-weighted K1 Gaussian mean ADE, earliest exact tie; paired same-checkpoint FDE
original_config.smoke_gate: all finite metrics/loss/gradients, nonzero gradient, checkpoint exact restore; continue same run, no validation improvement requirement
original_config.train_policy: other four nonETH original train regions only; held recording excluded entirely; original other val+embargo unused

comparison.CV: Last2=(X7-X6)/.4; OLS4/8 slope using centered true .4s time; all anchor atX7 and extrapolate12*.4s; no learned parameters
comparison.arithmetic: same float32 frozen positions and neural predictions promoted to float64 for distance sums; check old metric differences<=1e-6
comparison.metrics: K1 Gaussian mean ADE/FDE, mean of12 Euclidean positions and last Euclidean position, m
comparison.paired_keys: fold,window_id,agent_id,per-target future SHA256; no filtering; exact original frozen6886 targets

decisions.worthwhile: G1 ADE lower by>=max(.005,.01*G0), FDE increase<=max(.01,.02*G0_FDE), both recordings required; also compare all three CVs

extension.endpoint: 100 once, no further extension, no learning rate/structure/epsilon change; nonfinite stops affected run and reports incomplete
extension.frozen_optimizer: unchanged SGD.01, no momentum/decay/scheduler, clip1, batch16, accumulate64; same seed17+epoch ordering
extension.initialization: resume exact epoch30 model+optimizer+CPU/CUDA RNG, not restart
extension.rule: all four finite; trainNLL mean20:24 minus26:30>=.01, ADE reduction>=max(.005,.01*earlierADE), bestADE epoch>=28; all four must pass
extension.selection: min validation Gaussian-mean ADE across1..100, exact tie earlier; same checkpoint FDE; separately save original budget30 and epoch100

sensitivity.groups: historical mean speed<=.2 stationary,(.2,.8] low,(.8,1.6] normal walking,>1.6 fast; extra exact-stationary stepabs<=1e-8 and strict-stationary maxspeed<=.05+net<=.05m
sensitivity.interpretation: full fixed-network sensitivity plus local PTN hooks; no PTN-removal causal proof; overlapping windows dependent
sensitivity.noise: stable windowID+agentID keyed independent unit2D direction at each of8 points; same direction scaled byepsilon; all observed people jittered; no future GT
sensitivity.output: absolute position and relative-to-last forecast displacement shifts; actual inputRMS, gain P50/P95/P99/max; local PTN gain/lowvariance fraction; same jitter CV-Last2 calibration
sensitivity.primary: fixed_history_graph for feature/PTN sensitivity; recompute secondary includes edge threshold changes
sensitivity.risk_rule: at1mm, per-target max over2rep relative-final-shift>.1m and gain>100; group rate>=5% and>=30 unique people indicates repeated risk evidence, not iid significance or all-target claim
